info.title: NaturalTravel API
info.description: REST API for NaturalTravel, a platform for publishing, browsing, and saving travel stories across Ukraine. Authentication is session-based: login and registration set HttpOnly cookies (`sessionId`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`). Protected endpoints require both the `sessionId` and `accessToken` cookies.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, session refresh, and logout.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Public user profiles and authenticated user operations.

post.description: Creates a user account, hashes the password with bcrypt, creates a session and sets the `sessionId`, `accessToken`, and `refreshToken` HttpOnly cookies.

201.description: User registered successfully. Session cookies are set.

409.description: A user with this email already exists.

post.description: Validates the credentials, replaces any existing session for the user, creates a new session, and sets the session cookies.

200.description: Login successful. Session cookies are set.

post.description: Uses the `sessionId` and `refreshToken` cookies to issue a new access token and refresh token, then sets the updated session cookies.

200.description: Session refreshed. Updated session cookies are set.

401.description: Session not found or refresh token expired. Cookies are cleared.

post.description: Deletes the current session when valid `sessionId` and `refreshToken` cookies are present and clears all session cookies.

204.description: Logged out. Session cookies are cleared.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users with their name, avatar, and article count. Validated with celebrate/Joi.
Returns the authenticated user's document without the password or private avatar identifier.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's name and/or avatar. Send `multipart/form-data` with at least one of `name`, `avatar`, or `resetAvatar=true`. Sending both an avatar and `resetAvatar=true` is rejected.

400.description: Invalid name, avatar reset value, conflicting avatar/reset, or no update provided.

get.description: Returns stories authored by the authenticated user, newest first, with pagination.

200.description: Paginated list of the current user's stories.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's saved stories with pagination. Saved story IDs that no longer exist are filtered out.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of saved stories per page.

post.description: Adds a story to the authenticated user's saved stories. Saving another user's story increments the story rate once.

200.description: Story added to saved (or already saved).

delete.description: Removes a story from the authenticated user's saved stories. Removing another user's story decrements the story rate when it was previously saved.

200.description: Story removed from saved (or was not saved).

get.description: Returns a public user profile and the user's stories with pagination.

400.description: Invalid user ID or pagination parameters.

get.description: Returns stories with pagination, optional category filtering, and optional popularity sorting (`type=popular` sorts by rate descending).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Use `popular` to sort by rate descending.

400.description: Invalid page/limit, invalid category ID, or page exceeds total pages.

post.description: Creates a story for the authenticated user. The image is uploaded to Cloudinary under `natural-travel/stories`. On success the user's `articlesAmount` is incremented.

400.description: Missing fields, invalid field lengths, invalid category ID, category not found, or non-image upload.

get.description: Returns a single story with its author and category details.
Returns other stories in the same category as the given story, sorted by rate descending, with pagination.

400.description: Invalid story ID or pagination parameters.

500.description: Internal server error, including a story with no category.

sessionIdCookie.name: sessionId
sessionIdCookie.description: Session identifier cookie set on register, login, and refresh.

accessTokenCookie.name: accessToken
accessTokenCookie.description: Access token cookie set on register, login, and refresh. Valid for 15 minutes.

refreshTokenCookie.name: refreshToken
refreshTokenCookie.description: Refresh token cookie used by /api/auth/refresh. Valid for 1 day.

ObjectId.description: MongoDB ObjectId as a 24-character hexadecimal string.

resetAvatar.description: Set to `true` to reset the avatar to the default image. Cannot be combined with an uploaded avatar.

avatar.description: New avatar image (max 1 MB, image MIME type only).

article.example: A short account of a weekend hike in the Carpathian mountains.

image.description: Story image (max 1 MB, image MIME type only).

img.description: Cloudinary secure URL of the story image.

validation.description: Details about which request segment failed validation.
